Backlog after this run: 9 items pending (#12, #13, #14, #15, #16, #25, #32, #35, #36 new).

Search visibility: 30 queries re-checked against live SERPs on 2026-07-24. Meridian remains absent from top 10 for every checked query — no rank recoveries and no first-time surfacings. Standard -10 decay applied. Three notable competitor movements: (1) 'osteopath addington' — Performance Plus Physio has published /osteopath-addington-christchurch/ which now ranks #1 non-aggregator; previously a hollow UK-dominated SERP, so an NZ competitor has planted the first flag on Addington. (3) 'osteopath vs physiotherapist christchurch' — no recovery from last run's regression; Better Health now has a SECOND dedicated /resources/osteopath-vs-physiotherapy/ URL. Both (2) and (3) drive NEW item #36 — the comparison-URL pattern is now clearly locked-in. Notable positive (retained): 'paediatric osteopath christchurch' AI summary continues to name Nina Hu directly with her @meridianosteopathy.co.nz email + 02108655151 phone. Five new derived queries added: 'osteopath hoon hay' (Meridian's own suburb), 'cupping christchurch' (Min's TCM modality), 'acupuncture for menstrual pain christchurch' (Min's dysmenorrhoea specialty variant), 'chinese medicine christchurch' (broader intent), 'osteopath riccarton' (Triskelion + Happy Spine cluster). One query pruned ('headaches migraines osteopath christchurch' — 0 priority + redundant with newer 'headaches osteopath christchurch'). Pool size 49/50. First-time check for the five queries added 2026-06-05: 'acupuncture for endometriosis christchurch' — Burwood Acupuncture + House of Acupuncture both own dedicated URLs; 'acupuncture for pcos christchurch' — House of Acupuncture explicitly names PCOS training; 'acupuncture for cancer christchurch' — hollow SERP with NO incumbent dedicated URL, clearest single-query content opportunity identified this run given Min Jin's new post-cancer supportive-care specialty (PR #98); 'headaches osteopath christchurch' — Better Health + osteopath-christchurch.com own the pattern; 'post concussion syndrome christchurch' — Triskelion Concussion Care #1, Axis Sports Medicine's ACC-funded concussion clinic in top 4.

Industry signals (week of 2026-07-17 → 2026-07-24): (1) **Ahrefs July 2026 ChatGPT citation data** — Reddit at 16.7% of ChatGPT citations (up from 11.97% in Jan-Feb 2026 per 5WPR research), and Reddit remains the single most-cited source across ChatGPT/Claude/Gemini/Perplexity/AIO with ~40% multi-engine aggregate frequency. Wikipedia (13.15%) + Reddit (16.7%) together now account for >29% of ChatGPT US citations. Reinforces #15. (2) **Ahrefs May-2026 500M-event LLM-crawler study** — GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, OAI-SearchBot, Google-Extended overwhelmingly SKIP /llms.txt and crawl HTML directly. Google's John Mueller publicly compared llms.txt to the discredited keywords meta tag. Google has stated it doesn't support llms.txt and isn't planning to. Our llms.txt work (auto-generated from site data, plus rel=alternate link) is not wasted — it's B2A signalling — but this data further redirects future audit investment AWAY from schema/machine-readable side files and TOWARD on-page content depth/freshness. Reinforces #14. Do not add new llms.txt maintenance items on the strength of this signal alone. (3) **Conductor 2026 Healthcare AEO/GEO benchmarks** — AI Overviews now appear in 51% of US healthcare searches (>2× the all-industries average). Healthcare brands cited in AIOs earn 35% more organic clicks and 91% more paid clicks vs same-page uncited peers. 60%+ of healthcare queries now end without an external click. Ahrefs study of 1.9M AIO citations: 86% came from top-100 organic domains for the query — the 'get to top-100 organic first, then win AI citation' path is confirmed empirical, not just theoretical. (4) **Perplexity signal weighting** (Powered by Search / Demand Local July 2026) — Perplexity averages 8.79 citations/response and cites at 15.43% rate (vs ChatGPT 2.78%). Its five weighted signals are: freshness, structured Q&A formatting, authority within its curated pool, direct query-to-heading matches, citation density. Our citation-ready 40-60 word intros (item #31 shipped 2026-05-17) address 'direct query-to-heading match' and 'structured Q&A'; freshness gap (G8) still unaddressed. (5) **Google Search Console AI performance report** — UK subset only for now, opt-out toggle went live 2026-06-17 (past). Item #35 deadline has passed — status verification urgently needed. Google confirmed the toggle does NOT affect organic blue-link rankings, so leaving it ON is unambiguously the right call. NZ properties may still be pre-rollout; the check is 'is meridianosteopathy.co.nz verified as a property, and is the toggle left at default ON'. (6) **Content depth over quantity** (Winston Digital / Practicebeat 2026): 'Healthcare SEO is no longer about publishing as many pages as possible. Content depth and quality are critical; editorial strategies focused on comprehensive, well-researched content outperform high-velocity content creation.' Refines #14 — the ask is 1-2 comprehensive posts (900-1500 words each) with expert citations, not 2 shallow posts/month. Tier 1 → #35 (deadline passed, needs immediate verification). Tier 2 → #12, #13, #25, #32, #36 (new). Tier 3 → #14, #15, #16.

Keep this as tier 2 because speakable is genuinely voice-assistant-facing (different consumer than schema.org citation crawlers) but do not over-prioritise.

items.title: Auto-fetch Google Business Profile reviews at build time
items.body: So reviewCount / ratingValue stay current without manual edits. Build script hits Places API with a 24h cache. Reinforced 2026-06-05: local-SEO data shows reviews older than 18 months carry diminishing weight for AI citation confidence; content and signals updated within the past two months earn 28% more AI citations than older material. Reinforced 2026-07-24: Conductor 2026 Healthcare AEO/GEO benchmarks — AI Overviews now appear in 51% of US healthcare searches (>2× all-industries average), and 86% of AIO citations come from top-100 organic domains for the query (Ahrefs 1.9M-citation study). GBP is the primary data source for AI-driven local search per PinMeTo / MedRankSEO data; Google is replacing Maps Q&A with Gemini-generated answers pulled from GBP + reviews + the clinic website. Fresh review count + rating are direct inputs into that generated answer, so keeping the schema in sync with GBP feeds the Maps-surface answer generation as well as the on-site schema.

items.title: Start a blog (1–2 comprehensive posts/month)
items.body: Refined 2026-07-24: the target is 1–2 comprehensive posts per month (900–1500 words each with expert citations + Physician-schema byline + datePublished + dateModified + 3–5 FAQs), NOT 2 shallow posts/month. Winston Digital / Practicebeat 2026 pillar guides converge on: 'editorial strategies focused on comprehensive, well-researched content outperform high-velocity content creation.' Ahrefs analysis of 17M AI citations (April 2026): AI-cited content is 25.7% fresher than traditional Google organic results, and 76.4% of ChatGPT's top-cited pages were updated within the last 30 days. Confirmed again 2026-07-24: osteopath-christchurch.com still owns headaches/cranial/baby/teeth-grinding/stress/arthritis queries on one short blog post per condition, and MK Osteopathy still owns the jaw/TMJ slot via a dedicated blog post. TWO FRESH SIGNALS 2026-07-24: (a) Ahrefs 500M-event LLM-crawler study (May 2026) — GPTBot/ClaudeBot/PerplexityBot/OAI-SearchBot/Google-Extended overwhelmingly skip /llms.txt and crawl HTML directly. Schema and side-files are near-saturated; on-page content depth/freshness is the un-tapped lever. (b) Perplexity's five weighted signals per Powered by Search July 2026: freshness, structured Q&A formatting, authority within curated pool, direct query-to-heading matches, citation density — three of five are freshness/depth-linked. With /admin CMS coverage now filled (PR #91) AND the monthly Practitioner Spotlight cadence already established (PRs #108, #109), the editorial path is even shorter than before — a Decap 'blog' collection would slot into the existing spotlight workflow. Highest-latent-ROI item on the backlog.

items.title: Seed Reddit / community brand mentions
items.body: Genuine, non-spammy answers on r/newzealand / r/chch / r/AskNZ threads about osteopathy, ACC claims, back pain. Reinforced 2026-07-24 with fresh data: Reddit at 16.7% of ChatGPT citations per Ahrefs July 2026 study (up from 11.97% in 5WPR Jan-Feb 2026 study). Reddit + Wikipedia together account for >29% of all ChatGPT US citations. Perplexity share ~46.5% (stable). ~40% multi-engine aggregate citation frequency across ChatGPT/Claude/Gemini/Perplexity/AIO. Conductor research note: when LLMs do cite Reddit, sole-source citations rose 31% — Reddit is increasingly the only source for a given answer. ClaudeBot scaled 800% at start of 2026 — Reddit is increasingly the path into Claude's answers too. 90/10 rule: 90% non-promotional, 2–4 weeks of karma-building before any mention of Meridian.

items.title: Encourage monthly Google reviews nudge
items.body: Post-consultation email nudge via Resend (already wired). AI engines prefer reviews under 12 months old. Google's March 2026 core update weights review recency AND owner response rate more heavily than raw count. Healthcare best-practice = at least 1 new review/week. GBP is the primary data source for AI-driven local search across Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT and Perplexity location queries. Reinforced 2026-07-24: Conductor healthcare benchmarks show AIO trigger rate at 51% for US healthcare (>2× all-industries) and cited brands earn 35% more organic clicks + 91% more paid clicks vs same-page uncited peers — every fresh review compounds into both traditional GBP ranking and the AI-answer citation confidence. Combined with #13 (auto-fetch reviews at build time), this closes the GBP review-recency loop end to end.
